Based on Clause 9.3:

You gave notice on 1 March.
You move out on 20 March.
That is 19 days' notice, which is fewer than the required 60 days.

Under Clause 9.3.3, this means:

The Reinstatement Levy is 2 months' rent (instead of 1.5 months' rent).
Rent remains payable to the end of the 60-day notice period.
